US Strikes Iran After Tanker Attacks; Tensions Rise

The United States has conducted strikes against over eighty Iranian military targets, reportedly in response to recent attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump indicated a potential deal with Iran or further action, while Iran accused the US of major violations and vowed decisive action. The conflict is also noted to be reshaping geopolitical opportunities in Africa.
